decisions.title: The Agent Should Never Wait
decisions.description: Slow operations (long-running commands, network calls, file downloads) execute in the background. The agent continues reasoning and can check on results later. This keeps the agent responsive.
decisions.alternatives: Synchronous execution is simpler but blocks the agent entirely. Background execution adds complexity but dramatically improves throughput.

zh.title: Agent 永远不应该等待
zh.description: 慢操作在后台执行。agent 继续推理，可以稍后检查结果。这让 agent 保持响应性。
zh.alternatives: 同步执行更简单，但会完全阻塞 agent。后台执行增加了复杂性，但大幅提高了吞吐量。

decisions.title: Result Notification via Event Bus
decisions.description: When a background task completes, it pushes a notification to an event bus. The agent's main loop picks up notifications and processes results when it's ready, without polling.
decisions.alternatives: Polling (checking status periodically) is simpler but wastes tokens and time. Push-based notification is more efficient for the agent's flow.

zh.title: 通过事件总线通知结果
zh.description: 后台任务完成时，向事件总线推送通知。agent 主循环在准备好时获取通知并处理结果，无需轮询。
zh.alternatives: 轮询更简单，但浪费 token 和时间。基于推送的通知对 agent 流更高效。
